name: Prestige Glenbrook
codename: Rise at Home in the Heart of Nature
tagline: In the touch of the action. Insulated from the world.
overview: Prestige Glenbrook offers a wide choice of apartment configurations across two towers in Whitefield — from two-bed homes to spacious four-bed units — designed with intelligently managed circulation space for more usable area and excellent cross-ventilation. The development is close to the city's action yet insulated from it, with everyday needs and the workplace both within easy reach.
highlights: Two towers with configurations spanning 2, 3 and 4 bed homes
Rooms designed to be spacious, airy and bright with natural light
Intelligently managed circulation space for more usable area and excellent cross-ventilation
Clubhouse, swimming pool and change rooms within the master plan
Tennis court, basketball court and dedicated children's play area
Located in Whitefield, close to the workplace and everyday conveniences
